title: Explore quantitative research by market
intro: We use historical data to study prediction ideas and trading rules in stock and crypto markets. Choose a market to see the work and its findings.
scope: This site presents research and historical simulations. The results do not establish future performance or represent actual competition-account returns.
usBody: Keeping stocks whose rankings slipped usually reduced trading; returns improved less often.
usLimit: The comparison uses retained historical windows; real execution remains unverified.
cnnTitle: Letting a CNN read price charts
cnnBody: See the old experiment's input images, six related approaches and three simulated return curves.

moreBody: The project guide explains the data, methods and demonstrations you can run locally.
